What happened.task: Debug why the bot failed to close 6 Hyperliquid positions automatically.

what_went_well: Identified the exact wallet addresses involved.
Isolated the API rejection from the Python code.
what_went_wrong: Initially spent time looking for bugs in the Exchange() constructor parameters.
Key Insights.root_cause: The HYPERLIQUID_PRIVATE_KEY in .env belonged to an API Wallet (0x64a3...) that was NOT authorized for the main wallet (0xb867...) in the Hyperliquid settings. As a result, all signed market_close requests were rejected.

User Feedback.comments: The user provided the main wallet's private key successfully, bypassing the need for manual API authorization in the UI.
